label: Color filters
intent: Three overlapping color filters separate and blend again, the colour-vision filter setting. Light: the top filter pulls away from the centre, the lower two follow a beat apart, then all three slide back together and land overlapped with a hit and a small rebound. Strong: they squeeze in first, then spread further, hold apart for a beat and snap back together with a harder hit and two settling swings. They end exactly where they started.
//: Three r 6.2 circles at the corners of a triangle with 9.4 sides; each moves straight out from the triangle's centre (16, 17.37). The driver is top.y (negative is outward); the others follow along their own directions.
